:Halves casting time of Curses spells (Chance: 20%)

==Notes==
* The two chances for a halved casting time are [[w:Independence (probability theory)|independent]], and therefore calculated multiplicatively, giving a 36% chance to half casting time.
** Related to this calculation of two 20% events, there are two player terms that refer to associated modifiers:
*** [[20/20]] for caster items that have 20% chances to half casting time and recharge time, respectively.
*** [[40/20/20]] for [[staff|staves]] that have two HCT modifiers, like this item, but use a [[Of Enchanting|20% enchanting]] modifier rather than [[Of Fortitude|+30hp]].
